description: Deterministic proof gates for rest-api-v1. LLM output alone is never sufficient.

gates.description: All unified diffs apply cleanly to the copied baseline tree under Publish/{workflowId}/
gates.failureBehavior: Keep publish tree; set failureMessage; do not mark workflow success

gates.description: dotnet build on entryProject in the publish directory
gates.failureBehavior: Record buildOutput in manifest; applySucceeded may still be true

gates.description: Publish-tree OpenAPI is valid YAML/JSON; declared operations are covered by contract tests
gates.failureBehavior: Record openapiConsistencyOutput in manifest; do not mark workflow success

gates.description: dotnet test on fixture contract-test project in the publish directory
gates.failureBehavior: Record contractTestOutput in manifest; do not mark workflow success

deferred.description: Optional LLM Tester agent for richer API assertions
